title: Nusa Penida vs Gili Islands: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Nusa Penida for dramatic scenery and manta ray diving; Gili Islands for relaxed tropical beach vibes and sea turtles. Do both with 10+ days.

categories.name: Beaches & Swimming
categories.summary: Gili Islands have calm, swimmable lagoons. Nusa Penida's cliffs are photogenic but dangerous for swimming.

categories.name: Snorkeling & Diving
categories.summary: Nusa Penida has manta rays and Mola Mola; Gili Islands have sea turtles and beginner-friendly reefs.

categories.name: Scenery
categories.summary: Kelingking Beach, Broken Beach, and Angel's Billabong are among Indonesia's most dramatic landscapes.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Nusa Penida is cheaper overall — shorter boat from Bali and less developed infrastructure keeps prices lower.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: 45 min fast boat from Sanur vs 1.5–2h to Gili Islands. Nusa Penida wins on accessibility from Bali.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Gili Islands are car-free — walk or cycle everywhere. Nusa Penida requires a scooter or private driver on rough roads.

categories.name: Safety
categories.summary: Gili Islands have calm water and easy terrain. Nusa Penida has dangerous currents and hazardous cliff descents.

categories.name: Vibes
categories.summary: Three Gili options for any traveler: Gili T (party), Gili Air (chill), Gili Meno (romance). Nusa Penida is one-dimensional adventure.

categories.name: Nightlife
categories.summary: Gili Trawangan has real nightlife; Gili Air has beach bars. Nusa Penida is very quiet after dark.

categories.name: Instagram
categories.summary: Nusa Penida's cliff viewpoints are among Indonesia's most dramatic and photogenic landscapes.

categories.name: PADI Courses
categories.summary: Gili Islands are Indonesia's top spot for open water certification — calm conditions, multiple reputable dive shops.

faq.question: Is Nusa Penida or the Gili Islands better for snorkeling?
faq.answer: Both are excellent but for different experiences. Nusa Penida is unbeatable for manta rays at Manta Point and Crystal Bay's Mola Mola. The Gili Islands give you sea turtles almost guaranteed plus colourful reefs right from shore.

faq.question: How do you get to Nusa Penida vs the Gili Islands from Bali?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida: 45 min fast boat from Sanur, IDR 250,000–350,000 ($15–22) one way. Gili Islands: 1.5–2 hours fast boat from Padang Bai/Serangan, IDR 350,000–550,000 ($22–35) one way.

faq.question: Which is cheaper — Nusa Penida or Gili Islands?
faq.answer: Nusa Penida is slightly cheaper — shorter boat from Bali saves $10–15 each way, and accommodation runs IDR 150,000–900,000/night vs Gili's IDR 200,000–1,500,000/night.
